text:
jun: rolling out halley-v1 (q5_1 quant) to shadow; quick smoke shows BLEU down ~6 pts on ja/zh webnovel vertical samples, esp where ruby/furigana present. tokenization seems to split ruby markers into separate subtokens.
chen: can you paste the failing example?
jun: example lines attached below.
jun: Example: `「彼女〈かな〉は…」` produced tokens: `彼女`, `〈`, `かな`, `〉` instead of `彼女〈かな〉` — detok / alignment gets messed and model repeats context.
marta: that's suspicious. halley uses the new spm_v2 we trained with `--keep_marks` and slightly different normalizer. Did you use the same bin?
jun: yes, we used spm_v2 from the onboarding artifact. conversion used `spm_v2.model` + export flags in infra/convert/halley_export.py.
sandeep: my first thought: q5_1 quantization may have changed embedding indices or collisions for those rare marker tokens, but splitting suggests pre-tokenization or detok mismatch rather than pure quant noise.
jun: float32 run on the same fixtures shows BLEU delta ~0.6 only, while q5_1 shows ~6. So quant amplifies the failure once tokenizer/detok shifts token boundaries.
chen: I reproduced locally with the eval harness. command I ran: `pytest tests/evals/multilang_vertical.py::test_ruby_alignment -q` — failing case attached.
(eval-bot): snapshot attached — halley-v1 q5_1: ja_webnovel BLEU=28.3 (baseline=34.1); zh_vertical BLEU=30.2 (baseline=35.0); float32 BLEU=33.8. See /artifacts/evals/3781234567/ for diffs.
jun: minimal repro command for infra: ```
python infra/serve/smoke_test.py --model halley-v1 --quant q5_1 --input tests/fixtures/vertical_ruby.txt
```
marta: could the export step be pruning marker tokens? we added `prune_unused_tokens=true` in the conversion pipeline to shrink vocab for halley. If pruning removed combined tokens, spm would fall back to splitting.
sandeep: good call. If pruning removed composed markers like `〈...〉` entries, tokens will split and the model embedding index mapping shifts. That can interact badly with quantized embeddings where rounding/clipping changes nearest neighbor distances.
devex: paging @devex for tokenizer converter review. I can take a look at the conversion logs. Did we log the tokenmap size before/after prune?
jun: yes, conversion logs in s3://redwood-onboard/halley_v1/convert.log — grep shows `vocab_size before=50288 after=48012` and a note `removed markers: 145`.
chen: created issue ML-4721 with failing fixtures, logs and eval diffs linked.
sandeep: action plan: 1) bisect export step to confirm prune is root cause; 2) run float32 + q5_1 with original unpruned spm; 3) if confirmed, revert pruning for halley and re-run staging. I'll take step 1.
marta: if prune is the culprit we should add a guard in convert pipeline to never remove tokens containing non-alphanumeric markers `〈〉【】` etc. Also add a small unit test in tokenizer converter.
devex: noted. I'll draft a converter patch and a test that asserts marker tokens are preserved.
jun: also seeing weird RTL bracket reversal when we mix zh + ar in the same line — some detok bidi handling seems to have regressed when marker tokens are split. Might be same root cause.
chen: linking a sample: `中文 (العربية) 「...」` becomes `( العربية ) 中文 「...」` after detok. shows bidi shaping reversed.
eval-bot: linking eval harness run: /artifacts/evals/3781234567/bidi_mixedcase.html
jun: timeline: let's hold halley rollout until SRE confirms shadow SLA unaffected, but stop canary if we see user-facing regressions.
sandeep: assigning to me, will post bisect result here by EOD. :thumbsup:
jun: thanks — I'll upload failing fixtures and the full eval CSV to ML-4721.
deploy-bot: shadow-run completed on halley-v1 at 2026-03-19T09:12:34Z
chen: keep me posted, will help with bisect if needed.
